description:
Read the account behind this API key. Free, read-only, any key works. Returns:
- balance: total_usd, paid_usd, bonus_usd and bonus_expiring (amount_usd, expires_at)
- discount: this month's top-ups (month_topup_usd), the rate in effect and next (rate, threshold_usd, gap_usd = how much more to top up this month for it)
- rate_limit: requests_per_minute for all keys combined, key_requests_per_minute, and any rate package with its expires_at
- key: this key's id, name, prefix, created_at and expires_at
- usage_24h: calls, succeeded, failed and spent_usd in the last 24 hours (this_key: the same for this key)
Check the balance before a batch of paid calls; every paid call's billing also carries balance_after_usd.
name: everyinfra_get_account
title: Check account balance and limits
